review_description: Matt was very thorough with his quotes taking into account all my requirements/queries, supplying several quotes for different system options.The team put up with a lot of my questions and system changes (Panel & Inverter placement / wire routing) before and during installation and were always accommodating with everything, which was much appreciated.The end product with panel arrangement and power wire routing looks great. The system output turned out really well hitting 10 kW with the inverters even on cloudy days, very happy with the result!
